schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 17 reading marking instructions; 18–21 Léamhthuiscint A; 22–25 Léamhthuiscint B; 26 literature notes, the Gaeilge 5 note and the prose Eolas/Gaeilge table; 26–28 prose; 29–32 poetry; 33 Ceist 4 instructions and its Eolas/Gaeilge table; 34–41 additional literature; 42 modified marking (SMM). PDF 1–16 belong to Paper 1; 43–44 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover, 2 and 12 blank or acknowledgements, 3 instructions) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading (2020: Léamhthuiscint A and B both compulsory): all twelve questions of both passages are carded as whole questions; each printed part is also a practice card at its published tariff. “1 mharc + 1 mharc” answers expose one-mark slots (A1(b)(i), A2(b)(ii), A3(b)(ii), A5(b)(ii), B1(b)(ii), B2(b)(ii), B3(b)(i), B4(b)(i), B5(b)(ii)); “2 mharc + 1 mharc” items (A2(a), A4(a), A5(a), B3(a), B4(a) and both 6(a)) stay whole as 0/2/3.

A 6(b) prices two independent six-mark aims (aim 2 + support 4) and B 6(b) two independent six-mark reasons (reason 2 + discussion 4); each half is also a practice slot. Both must be in the candidate’s own words.
Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials and the full tariff).
Prose, poetry and Q4 choices are closed printed routes (2 + 2 + 6), each one card; the optional novel extract or poem itself is open content chosen inside one route.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 Léamhthuiscint A 50 and B 50 (Q1–5 at 7 = (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Q6 at 15 = (a) 3 + (b) 12); Ceist 2 Prós 30 (2A or 2B); Ceist 3 Filíocht 30 (3A or 3B); Ceist 4 Litríocht Bhreise 40 (one of 4A–4F).
Reading A “An tAthrú Aeráide” (paper 4–5, scheme PDF 18–21); B “An Ghaeilge agus Saol na Gaeilge” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 22–25).

Literature language: 5 marks for Gaeilge in every literature answer (scheme PDF 26); prose 25 Eolas; poetry printed (i) 15, (ii) 6, (iii) 9 on the paper, assessed as Eolas 13, 5, 7 plus Gaeilge 5 once; Q4 Eolas 35; 4F printed (i) 20, (ii) 10, (iii) 10, assessed as Eolas 19, 7, 9 (1 + 4 + 4) plus Gaeilge 5.

Text layer: the prose and Q4 band tables print the Eolas and Gaeilge columns side by side (scheme PDF 26 and 33); each literature answer closes with the examiner’s marking-panel note, after which the Marc as 4 table of the sub-question above is stored (PDF 30 and 41); the Plé (11 mharc) table of 3A(i)/3B(i) is stored after (ii)’s conditions and the Marc as 7 table of 4F(ii) after (iii)’s tariffs. The builder returns each table to the sub-question it prices and ends each answer at that note.
B 6(b): the scheme prints its tariff as “Dhá chúis = 6 mharc + 6 mharc”, not in the braces used for every other reading part.
No legacy cards exist for 2020 Higher Paper 2: every card is new, with IDs in the 2022–2026 pattern.
A 1(a): the scheme prints the full answer’s split inside it (“… in áit faoi leith (2 mharc) in imeacht tréimhse áirithe ama (1 mharc) = 3 mharc”); the card allows 0, 1, 2 and 3.

Scheme misprints, kept as printed: 3A(iii) “Ainm an file = Nuala Ní Dhomhnaill = 1 mharc” (after “Ainm an fhile = 1 mharc”); the Ceist 4 marking-panel note on PDF 41 says “an marc as 25 (Eolas)” although Ceist 4 is Eolas 35 (its panel prints “Eolas (35) =”). The note is the answer’s boundary and is not carried on any card.
